label: Talking head / UGC

kinds.clip: A trimmed piece of your footage with captions and a name lower third.
kinds.card: A branded text card between clips, e.g. a chapter title.
kinds.cta: Closing card: the one action viewers should take, with a button.

fields.asset: The video clip (.mp4, .webm or .mov) from the project assets.
fields.clip.text: What the speaker says in this clip, shown as captions.
fields.role: The speaker's role, shown under the name.
fields.zoom: in adds a slow punch-in on the clip; none keeps it still.
fields.vo: Optional voice line over this card.
fields.clip.layout: full (default) keeps the speaker full frame; split slides the speaker to one half and the screenshot into the other (left/right, or top/bottom in portrait); pip fills the frame with the screenshot and shrinks the speaker into a corner. Both run a quarter of the way into the clip.
fields.clip.image: The screenshot or picture (.png, .jpg, .webp) shown beside or behind the speaker with layout split or pip.

description: Edits real footage: trimmed clips with their own sound, burned-in captions from the clip text, a name and role lower third and an optional slow punch-in, a split screen or picture-in-picture beside a screenshot, joined by branded text cards and a closing call to action. Clips need .mp4, .webm or .mov uploads in the project's assets.

clip.text: What the speaker says in this clip, shown as captions.
